name: Math Smash: Animal Rescue
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Smash: Animal Rescue is a math game with a heroic adventure! These animals need a hero, and you are just the math whiz they need to save them. These dogs and cats have been naughty and climbed all the way to the top of these blocks. The blocks are falling down, and you must do your best to save them. Solve the math questions as quickly as you can to knock out some of the blocks before the animals fall off and hurt themselves! You will find the answer to your question among one of the blocks. Select one that is directly underneath the animal to help bring them down faster.  Earn coins along the way as you practice your math skills while also rescuing these adorable animals! There are various math skills you can select that range from preschool to the eighth grade. This math game offers decimals, addition, multiplication, geometry, and number properties.
